item.title: Quebec Independence Is Unlikely, but Some Will Still Dream
item.description: The idea of independence remains deeply unpopular in Quebec, yet the separatist Parti Québécois was re-elected to a minority government this week.

item.title: 7.7-Magnitude Panama Earthquake Sets Off Series of Aftershocks
item.description: The quake, which had a preliminary magnitude of 7.7, was centered in the country’s southern region.

item.title: Navi Pillay, South African Jurist, Is Awarded the Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: The choice drew condemnation from Israel over Ms. Pillay’s role leading a U.N. commission that said the country had committed genocide against Palestinians.
